groups.topic: Major physiographic divisions, Himalayas, plains, plateau, desert, coasts and islands
groups.fact_scope: IA02-P202-F01 through IA02-P227-F06, except source-sensitive peak and local-name rows retained for later topographic verification
verified: India has six major physiographic divisions in the NCERT treatment.
The Himalayas are geologically young fold mountains extending in an arc of about 2,400 km.
The Northern Plains are alluvial; the Peninsular Plateau is an ancient stable block dominated by igneous and metamorphic rocks.
Western Ghats are generally higher and more continuous; Eastern Ghats are discontinuous and cut by major rivers.
Lakshadweep is of coral origin; Andaman–Nicobar represents elevated submarine mountain systems in the standard school treatment.
corrections: Use the NCERT distribution plains 43%, mountains 30%, plateaus 27%; the book's 23% plateau figure is a typographical error.
Do not treat local width, height or superlative values as universal unless a single authoritative topographic series confirms them.
Explain geosyncline as an older model and plate convergence/collision as the modern framework.

groups.topic: Coral reefs and reef regions of India
groups.fact_scope: IA02-P228-F01 through IA02-P228-F04
verified: Fringing reefs, barrier reefs and atolls are the principal large-scale reef forms.
India's major reef regions include Gulf of Kachchh, Gulf of Mannar–Palk Bay, Lakshadweep and Andaman–Nicobar.
Barrier reefs occur on the western side of the Andaman Islands and atolls are characteristic of Lakshadweep.
corrections: Do not present 20° latitude, 70 m depth or any one temperature as a rigid universal coral-growth boundary.
Reef-area and species totals are survey-date dependent and are not used as timeless scored facts.

groups.topic: Lakshadweep islands, people, environment and channels

Kavaratti is the capital; Minicoy is the southernmost island and is separated culturally and linguistically from the northern group.
Malayalam is widespread and Mahl is spoken in Minicoy.
The low-lying islands are enclosed by reefs and lagoons; Agatti has the territory's airport.

groups.topic: Andhra Pradesh coastal plain and Eastern Ghats

groups.topic: Andaman–Nicobar tectonic setting and volcanic status
groups.fact_scope: IA02-P229-F01 through IA02-P231-F10: island-arc origin, Barren Island, Narcondam and the distinction between magmatic and mud-volcano processes
verified: The Andaman–Nicobar chain forms part of the Indo-Sumatra subduction-zone island-arc system.
Barren and Narcondam are volcanic islands on the inner arc of the subduction zone.
GSI identifies Barren Island as the only active volcano in South Asia and records basaltic lava and pyroclastic activity on several occasions since 1991.
Barren Island's magmatic eruptions must be distinguished from Baratang mud-volcano activity.
corrections: Use 'India's only confirmed active magmatic volcano' for Barren Island; do not extend this label to Baratang.
Do not score Narcondam's dormant/extinct label until a source using an explicit current classification is opened; its volcanic origin is verified.
Date-specific eruption claims require an official monitoring bulletin and are not treated as timeless facts.

groups.topic: Blue Flag certification meaning, criteria and time scope
groups.fact_scope: IA02-P239-F01 through IA02-P239-F05, limited to the certification concept rather than an unverified beach-by-beach list
verified: Blue Flag is an internationally recognised voluntary sustainability programme for beaches, marinas and tourism boats.
The programme evaluates environmental, educational, safety and accessibility criteria, including bathing-water quality and coastal management.
Awarded sites must maintain compliance throughout their designated Blue Flag season; the award is not a permanent once-for-all status.
The official site reports 13 awarded Indian beaches for the 2026 Northern Hemisphere season.
corrections: A beach must not be described as permanently Blue Flag certified.
Any Indian or Andhra Pradesh site list must carry its award season and be rechecked before use in a scored current-affairs question.
The chapter may score the stable certification concept, but a beach-by-beach current list remains pending.
